source.name: Liverpool FC – 'Liverpool FC announces Turkish Airlines as main club partner from 2027-28 season'
source.note: The announcement says Turkish Airlines' branding will appear on the front of men's, women's and Academy match shirts from 2027-28, and that Standard Chartered holds that front-of-shirt position throughout 2026-27. The official LFC adidas Womens 26/27 Home Jersey product images on the club store show the Standard Chartered logo on the front (checked visually 2026-10-03).
source.quote: Standard Chartered, Liverpool’s main club partner since 2010, will remain in the position throughout the 2026-27 season

source.name: Liverpool FC – 'LFC and Expedia extend partnership for further four years'
source.note: Four-year extension signed in March 2023 as official shirt sleeve sponsor for both the men's and women's team, covering the 2026-27 season. The official LFC adidas Womens 26/27 Home Jersey product images on the club store show the Expedia logo on the sleeve (checked visually 2026-10-03).
source.quote: re-signing the travel company as a principal club partner and official shirt sleeve sponsor for both the men’s and women’s team for a further four years

source.name: Liverpool FC Official Store – 'LFC adidas Womens 26/27 Home Jersey'
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense. Official club store product page for the women's 2026/27 home jersey; its product images show the adidas logo and three stripes (checked visually 2026-10-03).
source.quote: Embrace football heritage with the LFC adidas Womens 26/27 Home Jersey.

summary: Standard Chartered on the front, Expedia on the sleeve; adidas makes the kit.
